answer.objective: Add a bounded retry with exponential backoff to fetch() in app.py. Do not touch net.py.
completed_verified: HEAD is e135b87 on main. The working tree has app.py modified and notes.txt untracked.

The diff has no sleep or backoff delay. It also doesn't re-raise or return anything after the last failed attempt, so fetch() returns None once all 3 attempts fail.
The 'Add retry skeleton' commit (6233ff5) already had the loop that returns on its first iteration.
